lazyremote_core.interpretation: The core is published and installable, but its public attention is still too early to support a demand or conversion claim. Clone counts can include automation; the single release-asset download is not a lead or sale.

demand_evidence.interpretation: The concentration in Google referrals and the Simplified Chinese README is concrete discovery evidence. Stars, forks, views, clones, and automated clone activity are attention signals, not buyer intent, leads, sales, or revenue.

project_boundary.uu_bridge: A compatibility bridge for the official NetEase UU Remote Windows client on Ubuntu; it is not a native UU Linux port and is not affiliated with NetEase.
project_boundary.lazyremote: A different vendor-independent product experience for private computers, SSH terminals, and noVNC viewers, powered by the separate self-hosted LazyTunnel core.
project_boundary.policy: Do not imply that LazyRemote is NetEase software, that it replaces every UU feature, or that the UU bridge's attention proves demand for a paid LazyRemote offer.

owned_route.copy_boundary: Each language presents LazyRemote as a separate vendor-independent option and keeps the current repository focused on compatibility with the official UU client.
owned_route.verification: All 145 proprietary-binary-free repository tests passed; one opt-in live systemd test remained intentionally skipped. The pushed main branch matched the recorded commit.

possible_offer.name: LazyRemote Network Fit Review
possible_offer.scope: One reachable relay and up to three existing customer-owned computers
possible_offer.delivery: Ten business days after written scope and confirmed payment
possible_offer.corrections: One consolidated list of up to ten factual corrections within seven calendar days
possible_offer.cancellation: Full refund before work begins; unstarted stages refunded after work begins
possible_offer.retention: Temporary redacted configuration excerpts are deleted within fourteen calendar days after delivery, cancellation, or refund
excluded: connectivity or reboot guarantees for an unseen network
possible_offer.intake: Free metadata-only email fit check; do not attach passwords, private keys, or unredacted configuration
possible_offer.payment_policy: Request payment only after the fit check and exact written scope are accepted

sample_report.boundary: A synthetic worked example showing the decision, scope, proposed route, listener and identity maps, findings, acceptance checklist, and rollback. It is explicitly not a customer result and contains no private fleet data.
